name: Sawasdee River Tour
notes: Chao Phraya day tour. TAT-licensed since 2019. Verified phone, license, and bank account in directory.

name: Issaya Siamese Club
notes: Independent registered restaurant in directory. Use marked taxis or hotel transport for return trips.

name: Bangkok Airport Rail Link
notes: Official airport rail. Use ticket machines or counter; ignore private touts at the platform.

name: Bangkok City Wheels Rental
notes: Card or refundable cash deposit. Will not require original passport. Insurance included.

name: Phuket Blue Island Trips
notes: Phi Phi day tour. TAT-licensed boat operator. Refunds processed through official channel.

name: Phuket Sunrise Yoga & Wellness
notes: Licensed wellness studio. Patong location. Verified card payments and printed receipts.

name: Patong Reef Scooter Hire
notes: Refundable cash deposit only. Photo of passport accepted in place of original.

name: Chiang Mai Local Wheels
notes: Verified scooter rental in Old City. Helmet included, deposit returned at end of rental.

name: Doi Suthep Heritage Tours
notes: Half-day temple tour. TAT-licensed guide. Pickup from hotels in Nimman and Old City.

name: Nimman Coffee House
notes: Independent registered cafe with printed receipts and posted menu prices.

name: Pattaya Blue Reef Diving
notes: PADI-certified dive operator. TAT-licensed. Insurance included in booking.

name: Pattaya Beach Songthaew Co-op
notes: Official shared baht-bus loop on Beach Road. 10-20 THB posted fares.

name: Pattaya Sea Breeze Spa
notes: Licensed spa with itemised menu. Avoid touts who offer cheaper street pickups.

name: Sukhumvit Express Tours
notes: Demo entry: aggressive LINE-only sales, claims TAT but no verifiable license in directory. Caught one in late 2025.

name: Patong Jet Adventure
notes: Demo entry: known for damage-cash-pressure pattern at Patong beach. No verifiable TAT/rental license.
